mapper.update: UPDATE match_event SET current_participants = current_participants + 1 WHERE id = #{eventId} AND current_participants < max_participants AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_registration ( id ,user_id, event_id, check_in_status, create_time , update_time, deleted) VALUES (default,#{userId},#{eventId},default,default,default,default )
mapper.select: SELECT b.* FROM event_registration a INNER JOIN match_event b ON a.event_id = b.id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.deleted = 0 AND b.deleted = 0
